bagPolicy.summary: ESSENCE Festival spans multiple venues, so there is not one bag rule for the entire weekend. The Caesars Superdome evening concert series requires stadium-compliant clear bags; daytime Convention Center rules can differ.
bagPolicy.note: Check the E360 app and the rules for the specific ESSENCE event/venue you are attending.

parking.note: Ample parking is available at the Convention Center for a daily fee, but overnight parking is prohibited. ADA parking is available, and specific needs can be addressed via email.

rideshare.note: If arriving or departing by taxi or rideshare, use the designated Taxi/Rideshare Zone.

concessions.note: The venue features Dutch’s Corner, an in-house convenience store located next to the UPS Store in Lobby E. It offers a variety of snacks and beverages for attendees.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Essence Festival of Culture, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Essence Festival of Culture's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Essence Festival of Culture. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Essence Festival of Culture. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
